li.label: survived goblin captivity
li.description: Ugh... Those disgusting goblins. Why did they keep me alive? What are they planning? At least, while I am alive, there is still hope of escape.

li.label: goblin slave
li.description: I must be useful for something if they have not eaten me... It is a miserable life, but I am relieved to have even a little more time alive.
